the German version of QoL AD-NH is a reliable, valid and responsive instrument for the measurement of the QoI of people with dementia in NHs, and that the German version is suitable for proxy rating of people with mild to moderate dementia from the proxy proxy perspective.

the crosscultural adaptation process of the QoI AD NH was successful and the German version of QoL AD 13 item NH was rated in a way similar to the original English QoL AD by caregivers as proxy rat ers.

(1) a German version of the Qol AD NH was developed, (2) the QoLAD NH is a feasible instrument for the proxy rating of Qo L of persons with dementia, and (3) the Qo LAD NH has high internal consistency, high test retest reliability, and good validity.

the translation of the German QoL AD and its NH version.
the crosscultural adaptation and pre testing of a QoL instrument for people with dementia living in NHs.
the crosscultural adaptation and cognitive pre testing of the German version (proxy) of the QoI AD NH.

the QoLAD NH can be used as a proxy rating scale for QoL for people living in NHs with a formal dementia diagnose.

the German version of QoL AD-NH is now available for proxy rating and that a proxy proxy perspective is not the best option.
